_comment: Cards for tests/unit/triggers/test_sacrificed_to_activate.py. Never part of a deck list. `t_sta_watcher` is Ashnod the Uncaring's trigger condition with the copy replaced by 'each opponent loses 3 life', so whether it fired is visible on a life total the fodder abilities never touch; a noncreature artifact, so no creature-sacrifice cost can take the watcher itself. `t_sta_unsacrificed` is the same trigger with `sacrificed_to_activate: false`, the clause read the other way. The abilities under test are the shared ones: t_gisa_outlet (sacrifice), t_sp_lands (list-form sacrifice), t_sx_squirrel (sacrifice X), t_mutator (no sacrifice) and the Treasure token (a mana ability that sacrifices). t_sac_outlet (an Enchantment's ability, outside the filter) is the anchor that keeps the Treasure position from auto-passing.

cards.name: Test Sacrifice Watcher
cards.oracle_text: Whenever you activate an ability of an artifact or creature that isn't a mana ability, if one or more permanents were sacrificed to activate it, each opponent loses 3 life.

abilities.text: Whenever you activate an ability of an artifact or creature that isn't a mana ability, if one or more permanents were sacrificed to activate it, each opponent loses 3 life.

cards.name: Test Unsacrificed Watcher
cards.oracle_text: Whenever you activate an ability of an artifact or creature that isn't a mana ability, if no permanents were sacrificed to activate it, each opponent loses 1 life.

abilities.text: Whenever you activate an ability of an artifact or creature that isn't a mana ability, if no permanents were sacrificed to activate it, each opponent loses 1 life.
